question: Which instrument here is speech, and how various its effects?
premises: end, prana-support — but which action here is instrument indeed: speech
and of these, various in effects are functions
inference: Speech is the act-instrument; functions vary across effects.
uncertainties: anta (end) as breath-limit kept per gloss
plain_english: End, prana-support — but which action here is instrument indeed: speech. Said in summary, and of these various in effects are functions.
